title: Good scissors with way too much other stuff getting in the way. ** Falling apart **
text:
Good scissors with way too much other stuff getting in the way. ** Falling apart **. This is one of those cases of a product that is trying to do too many things at once and getting in its own way. The good things first. The basic function as scissors is really good and these are sharp indeed. The handle is comfortable to hold and doesn't pinch your fingers. These break apart for thorough cleaning and go back together easily. I love the magnetic holding case as well - it popped into the refrigerator and keeps these handy, but up out of the way rather than cluttering up my drawer space.

The reasons for deducting two stars is because the other multi function parts just don't work very well and get in the way. The nut cracker part requires brute hand strength and my regular nut cracker is easier to use. The bottle opener wouldn't fit and grip on the cap of a glass bottle Coca-Cola - I had to use the 30 year church key opener. One last issue to consider is the sharp, pointy ends on the handles - Reaching to pull these scissors out of the holding case, I have poked myself twice on those pointy ends. I received a free sample pair of these scissors for testing and review.

APRIL 2016 UPDATE Reduction to two stars
*** The case has begun to fall apart and the magnet has fallen off entirely. ****
